CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR SINHA  ORAL ORDER 7 16-01-2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties concerned.
The dispute involved in this case is that the land belonging to the petitioners situated at Khata No.
29 (new-17), Plot No. 56 (new-65) admeasuring 1 bigha 7 Katha 16 dhur situated in Mouza Lagauli (Dholipur), Thana No. 520, Touzi No. 5047, is being used by the respondents/State for its own purpose without giving any compensation to the petitioners.
Patna High Court CWJC No.14661 of 2021(7) dt.16-01-2023

A counter affidavit has been filed by the District Fisheries Officer, Begusarai,
Shashi Bhushan Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 16 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4458706/
1 stating therein that the land in question was donated to the State by the ancestors of the petitioners for the construction of "Sumitra Kanya High School", Tilrath, and at present the said school is running over the land in question and the Fisheries Department has got no concern with this land.

entities.text:
District Fisheries Officer, Begusarai,
Shashi Bhushan Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners in this writ petition has claimed that the land in question is being utilized by the Fisheries Department and the same is being used for the Fisheries Training School without following the procedure under Land Acquisition Act.
This Court by an order dated 19.12.2022 had appointed Mr. Vivek, as an Advocate Commissioner to visit the spot and give a report with regard to the user of the subject land.

In pursuance thereof, the learned Advocate Commissioner has submitted his report along with the photographs of the land in question and has concluded that no school in the name of "Sumitra Kanya High School" was ever functional nor the place mentioned in the writ petition was occupied by the school.

A copy of the letter issued by the Block Education Officer, Barauni, has also been annexed with the report from which it appears that no school in the name of "Sumitra Kanya High Patna High Court CWJC No.14661 of 2021(7) dt.16-01-2023 School" is situated in Barauni Block.

entities.text: Sumitra Kanya High Patna High Court
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text: In view of the report of learned Advocate Commissioner, prima facie it appears that a false and misleading statement has been made in the counter affidavit by the respondent No. 4 regarding High School being run from the premises in question.

Accordingly, issue notice to respondent No. 4, i.e. the District Fisheries Officer, Fisheries Department, Begusarai, as to why an appropriate proceeding for filing false affidavit be not initiated against him.

entities.text: District Fisheries Officer, Fisheries Department, Begusarai
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Notice is to be sent at the cost of the office.
The concerned Officer shall be present in person on the next date fixed in the notice along with his show cause.
Learned counsel for the State is permitted to go through the copy of the report submitted by the learned Advocate Commissioner.
The District Magistrate, Begusarai, is directed to pay a sum of Rs.15,000/- to the Advocate Commissioner as his remuneration for visiting and submitting his report upon the subject land.
The aforesaid amount must be paid within two weeks to the learned Advocate Commissioner.

Put up this case on 20th February, 2023 under Patna High Court CWJC No.14661 of 2021(7)
dt.16-01-2023 appropriate heading.

(Anil Kumar Sinha, J) S.Ali/-
